narrative: On the bookwheel. Holinshed open under the brass weight. A finger keeps Daniel open at the same place. The draft sheet is pushed to the side. On the bookwheel. The finger has not moved. The two openings face each other. The pen is not on the draft.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the two openings against each other, and copied nothing.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on book in Two books at the same place
